data.name: Budu
data.long_meaning: The name Budu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'budhah', meaning wise or intelligent. It is also associated with the Buddha, representing the enlightened one. In Hindu mythology, Budu is a name for the deity Ganesha, the elephant-headed god who is the remover of obstacles.

data.cultural_impact: The name Budu has a significant impact on Indian culture, particularly among communities in South India. It is a common name for both boys and girls and is often used as a term of respect or endearment for elders. In some regions, it is also used as a nickname or surname. This shows the importance of wisdom and intelligence in Indian society, as embodied in the name Budu.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the name Budu holds great spiritual significance as it represents the attainment of wisdom and enlightenment. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding, both in this life and in the spiritual realm. Moreover, the association of Budu with Ganesha underscores the idea of overcoming obstacles and achieving success through intelligence and perseverance. Thus, the name Budu is not only a source of inspiration but also a reminder of the spiritual journey towards self-realization.
